description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Evaluation Context Length and PPL (perplexity) for different values of gamma. The x-axis represents Evaluation Context Length, with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2K to 64K, and tick labels at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis represents PPL, with a linear scale, ranging from 7.7 to 8.2, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are shown, each representing a different gamma value: γ=0.25 (blue, solid line), γ=0.5 (orange, dashed line), and γ=0.75 (green, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 8.2 at 2K, decreases to around 7.85 at 4K, increases slightly to about 7.88 at 8K, then decreases to 7.8 at 16K, increases slightly to 7.81 at 32K, and finally decreases to 7.8 at 64K. The orange line starts at approximately 8.2 at 2K, decreases to around 7.84 at 4K, then continues to decrease to about 7.73 at 8K, 7.72 at 16K, 7.71 at 32K, and 7.71 at 64K. The green line follows a similar trend to the orange line, starting at approximately 8.2 at 2K, decreasing to around 7.84 at 4K, then continuing to decrease to about 7.73 at 8K, 7.72 at 16K, 7.7 at 32K, and 7.7 at 64K.
